facts.text: Stanton's star is a G-type main-sequence star, also named Stanton.
Each of Stanton's four planets is owned by a megacorporation.
Crusader is the second planet of Stanton, owned by Crusader Industries.
The navjumper Toshi Aaron discovered Stanton, and the UEE later sold its planets to corporations.
Stanton has jump points to Magnus, Nyx, Terra and Pyro.
A jump point links Stanton to the Pyro system.
facts.note: rewritten in-universe 2026-09-23 (was out-of-universe: patch number / 'the game' / developers)

facts.text: Crusader is a low-mass gas giant with a breathable atmosphere at high altitude.
Crusader is owned by Crusader Industries, which builds ships on platforms in its skies.
Crusader has three moons: Cellin, Daymar and Yela.
Crusader's landing zone is Orison, a city in the clouds.
Crusader's floating platforms were first built by the military, then expanded by Crusader Industries.
Crusader's low gravity lets workers build ships in open air without suits.
Orison is a network of large interconnected platforms floating in Crusader's atmosphere.
Orison's spaceport is August Dunlow Spaceport, named after the founder of Crusader Industries.
Cloudview Center is Orison's commercial hub.
Providence is Orison's industrial platform, home to Crusader's shipyards.
Inspiration Park holds the corporate headquarters of Crusader Industries.
Orison holds its altitude with Seraph-class thrusters.
Crusader gardeners bred the Hosanna tree to survive high winds, with scented pink flowers.
Orison is one of the major landing zones in Stanton.
facts.note: rewritten in-universe 2026-09-23 (was out-of-universe: patch number / 'the game' / developers)

facts.text: The Stormwal is a flying creature, often called the space whale.
facts.note: rewritten in-universe 2026-09-23 (was out-of-universe: patch number / 'the game' / developers)

facts.text: Stormwals live in the atmosphere of Crusader, adapted to the gas giant's conditions.
Adult Stormwals reach about a hundred meters long, usually with pale pink striping.
Stormwals feed on aeroplankton and small creatures called kiami.
Crusader Industries adopted the Stormwal as its mascot.
A Stormwal sculpture called Until Again, by Bipasha Zhu, stands at Cloudview Center in Orison.
The Valakkar is a giant sandworm, not a space whale, native to Leir III.
August Dunlow founded Crusader Industries by buying the shuttle maker Seraphim Systems and renaming it.
August Dunlow was an anti-Messer activist who wanted the company's profits to fund charitable causes.
CEO Kelly Caplan bought the gas giant Crusader as the company's consolidated headquarters.
Crusader Industries is one of four UEE corporations that own a planet.
Crusader Industries is headquartered in Orison on Crusader.
Crusader Industries builds the Hercules military transport and the Mercury Star Runner.
Crusader Security is Crusader Industries' private security force.
Crusader Security polices Crusader's gravitational sphere, including Cellin, Daymar and Yela.
Crusader Security keeps a lean force and leans heavily on hired security contractors.
Crusader Security counts the Nine Tails pirates among its rivals.
Cellin is a moon of the gas giant Crusader.
Cellin is named after the youngest of three siblings in the children's tale A Gift for Baba.
Cellin has over a hundred volcanoes, long dormant, and thermal geysers that erupt without warning.
Cellin's thin, toxic atmosphere is mostly sulfur dioxide.
Terra Mills HydroFarm and Hickes Research Outpost are on Cellin.
Security Post Kareah orbits Cellin.
Daymar is a moon of Crusader, named after one of the siblings in A Gift for Baba.
Daymar's toxic atmosphere is mainly nitrogen and methane, so explorers need full environmental protection.
The Daymar Rally is a yearly race through three outposts across Daymar's surface.
Shubin Mining Facility SCD-1 and Kudre Ore both operate on Daymar.
Comm Array ST2-47 orbits Daymar.
Two abandoned Hathor mining sites, Attritus and Lamina, orbit Daymar.
Yela is the furthest moon orbiting the gas giant Crusader.
Yela's water-ice crust is said to reflect the cool, calculating character it is named after.
Yela has its own asteroid belt, home to many small locations of interest.
The outlaw station Grim HEX sits in Yela's asteroid belt.
ArcCorp Mining Area 157 and Deakins Research Outpost are on Yela.
Wikelo's Selo Station is an asteroid base near Yela.
Grim HEX is a sealed station built into an asteroid orbiting Yela.
Grim HEX began as a housing exchange for mining workers, built by Everline Structures.
After the housing exchange officially closed, outlaws, pirates and criminals took Grim HEX over.
Grim HEX serves as the headquarters of the Nine Tails.
Grim HEX offers ship repair, rearm and refuel, a clinic, and shops for weapons and clothing.
The Nine Tails are an outlaw faction that specialises in piracy.
The Nine Tails often disable comm arrays around Crusader, blinding local security.
The Nine Tails run forward bases on Yela, Daymar, Cellin and microTech.
Nine Tails ships wear red and black liveries.
Mendo Ren is one of the Nine Tails' leadership figures.
Comm arrays provide comm coverage and ECN services to a sector of space.
While a comm array is disabled, no CrimeStat is registered in its area.
Four comm arrays serve Crusader: ST2-28 at Cellin, ST2-47 at Daymar, ST2-55 at Crusader, ST2-76 at Yela.
Stanton's comm arrays are owned and operated by Aciedo.
The Hathor Group was an interplanetary mining concern notorious for environmentally catastrophic strip mining.
Hathor sank its last funds into mining Stanton, hit unforeseen trouble, and was formally dissolved.
Each Hathor site pairs an orbital laser platform with a cluster of planetary alignment facilities.
The Hathor sites Attritus and Lamina orbit Daymar; Ruptura and Vivere orbit Aberdeen.
Wikelo is a Banu who retired from a fabrication Souli and moved to human space.
Wikelo offers collection contracts that pay out in armor, weapons, ships and ship components.
Wikelo runs three emporiums in Stanton: Dasi Station, Selo Station and Kinga Station.
Selo Station, Wikelo's Crusader emporium, is an asteroid base near Yela.
Seraphim Station is a Rest and Relax station in the trade lanes above Crusader.
Seraphim Station replaced Port Olisar above Crusader.

facts.text: Seraphim Station is named after Seraphim Systems, the shuttle maker that became Crusader Industries.
Seraphim Station offers ship rentals, repair and refuel, cargo, and a medical clinic.
Port Olisar was taken down and replaced by Seraphim Station.

facts.text: Security Post Kareah is a security station orbiting Cellin.
Conservation posters at Kareah say Crusader is dedicated to protecting the Stormwals.
Hurston is a Super-Earth planet in Stanton, owned by Hurston Dynamics.
Hurston's atmosphere is practically identical to Earth's.
Mining and manufacturing on Hurston have killed almost all of its indigenous life.
Lorville is Hurston's planetary capital and primary spaceport.
Hurston's four moons are Aberdeen, Arial, Ita and Magda.
Hurston Dynamics bought Hurston from the UEE in a deal worth an estimated fifty trillion credits.
Hurston Security is responsible for law enforcement in Hurston's jurisdiction.
Lorville is a company town Hurston Dynamics established for its employees on Hurston.
Lorville's spaceport is Teasa Spaceport.
Lorville is surrounded by a wall that dwarfs even decently sized ships.
Lorville exists in the shadow of Central Tower, the corporate headquarters of Hurston Dynamics.
Lorville's name comes from LOR, short for Local Occupational Residency.
Lorville has a Central Business District, a Workers District, and six city gates on its perimeter.
Lorville was founded in 2912.
Solomon Hurston founded Hurston Dynamics in 2438.
Hurston Dynamics is one of the longest continuously operating family businesses in the Empire.
Hurston Dynamics manufactures ship weapons and munitions, and refines antimatter.
Gavin E. Hurston is the current CEO of Hurston Dynamics.
Hurston Dynamics owns the planet Hurston and is headquartered in Lorville.
Hurston Security is the internal security force of Hurston Dynamics.
Hurston Security has a rivalry with the United Workers of Hurston.
Aberdeen is a moon of Hurston.
Aberdeen's sulfur-rich atmosphere gives the moon a yellow tint.
Daytime temperatures on Aberdeen commonly reach 230 degrees Celsius.
Aberdeen is named after Aberdeen Hurston, designer of the first Hurston Dynamics antimatter warhead.
Aberdeen is known primarily as the home of the Klescher Rehabilitation Facility.
HDMS-Norgaard and HDMS-Anderson are mining outposts on Aberdeen.
Arial is a moon of Hurston.
Arial is named after Arial Hurston, Hurston Dynamics' third CEO, known for a controversial employee contract.
Arial's atmosphere is mostly nitrogen and is toxic to humans.
Arial's surface temperatures sit considerably above the boiling point.
HDMS-Bezdek and HDMS-Lathan are mining outposts on Arial.
Ita is a moon of Hurston.
Ita is named after Ita Hurston, who died during the First Tevarin War.
Ita's atmosphere is almost entirely nitrogen, with traces of methane and carbon monoxide.
Breathing equipment is required for all surface activities on Ita.
HDMS-Ryder and HDMS-Woodruff are mining outposts on Ita.
Comm Array ST1-02 covers Ita's airspace.
Magda is a moon of Hurston.
Magda is named after Magda Hurston, the CEO who decided to buy Stanton I from the UEE.
Magda's atmosphere is mostly nitrogen and toxic, so breathing equipment is required.
HDMS-Hahn and HDMS-Perlman are mining outposts on Magda.
The Klescher Rehabilitation Facility is an automated prison on Aberdeen.
Inmates at Klescher work off their sentences by serving time and performing mining labor.
Klescher inmates earn merits, mostly by mining in its caves, to shorten their sentences.
The prison on Aberdeen is run by the corporation of the same name, Klescher Rehabilitation Facilities.
Klescher inmates can spend merits on medical supplies and nutrition bars at the commissary.
The Klescher facility on Aberdeen has one escape route.
microTech is a large and generally cold Super-Earth in Stanton.
An early terraforming error left microTech far colder and harsher than first projected.
Temperatures on microTech generally sit well below zero, especially during severe snowstorms.
The planet microTech is home to the microTech corporation.
New Babbage is the largest city on microTech and a major trading hub.
microTech has three moons: Calliope, Clio and Euterpe.
MT Protection Services enforces the law in microTech's jurisdiction.
New Babbage is the largest city on microTech and a major trading hub.
New Babbage is the headquarters of the software and electronics maker microTech.
New Babbage Interstellar Spaceport sits outside the city, on the opposite side of a frozen lake.
Large public spaces in New Babbage are enclosed under domes against the freezing elements.
The cold climate draws small tech companies housing heat-sensitive computing to New Babbage.
Magnus Tobin founded New Babbage.
New Babbage includes The Commons, New Babbage Plaza, the Promenade and Aspire Grand.
microTech makes personal computing devices like the mobiGlas, plus spacecraft computers and datapads.
Magnus Tobin founded microTech.
microTech was incorporated in 2782 but struggled to turn a profit in its early years.
Released in 2818, the mobiGlas became an instant success, worn across the empire.
microTech is headquartered in New Babbage on the planet microTech.
MT Protection Services enforces the law in microTech's jurisdiction.
Calliope is a moon orbiting microTech.
Calliope is named after the ancient Greek muse who inspires eloquence.
Calliope gets so cold at night that even exceptionally insulated weather suits can fail.
Calliope is beset by high winds and low temperatures.
Rayari runs the Anvik and Kaltag research outposts on Calliope.
Raven's Roost is an unmarked location on Calliope.
Clio is a moon orbiting microTech.
Clio is named after the ancient Greek muse of history.
Clio is too cold for surface activity without environmental survival gear.
Rayari Cantwell and Rayari McGrath research outposts are on Clio.
Comm Array ST4-59 covers Clio's airspace.
Euterpe is the smallest of microTech's three moons.
Euterpe has vast frozen oceans and exposed ice sheets.
Euterpe was one of the Muses in Greek mythology, presiding over music.
The only oxygen in Euterpe's atmosphere is fixed in trace water vapor.
Bud's Growery, Devlin Scrap and Salvage, and The Icebreaker racetrack are on Euterpe.
ArcCorp is a Super-Earth in Stanton, owned and terraformed by the ArcCorp corporation.
ArcCorp is covered in layer after layer of factory, so building more is now impossible.
The UEE claimed ArcCorp, and in 2865 sold it to the company.
Area18 is one of ArcCorp's main commercial ports for interplanetary traffic.
ArcCorp has two moons, Lyria and Wala.
Area18 is one of the main commercial ports for interplanetary traffic around ArcCorp.
Riker Memorial Spaceport is the main hub for leaving and entering Area18.
ArcCorp Plaza is the main plaza of Area18, with Memphis Avery's iconic floating sculpture.
The IO-North tower is ArcCorp's premier center for business development, with 172 levels.
ArcCorp hired the notorious private security firm BlacJac Security to keep the peace in Area18.
The Bevic Convention Center is in Area18.
ArcCorp makes jump modules, quantum drives, spacecraft engines and industrial mining equipment.
ArcCorp also builds terraforming platforms.
ArcCorp was founded in 2687 as a deep-space exploration consortium.
ArcCorp started in a Stor-All hangar, begun by a group of friends.
ArcCorp later shifted from exploration to mining.
ArcCorp is headquartered on its own planet, ArcCorp, in Stanton.
Lyria is a moon orbiting ArcCorp.
Lyria's icy surface has dirty ice, active cryogeysers and cryovolcanoes.
Lyria has a very thin atmosphere made mostly of oxygen.
Humboldt Mines and the Loveridge Mineral Reserve are on Lyria.
Shubin runs several mining and processing facilities on Lyria.
Security Depot Lyria-1 stands on Lyria.
Wala is a moon orbiting ArcCorp.
Wala has a barren surface with outcrops of geode-like minerals.
Wala's air is too thin to breathe, but pressure suits can extract oxygen from it.
ArcCorp runs several mining areas and processing centers on Wala.
Shady Glen Farms and Samson and Sons Salvage Center are on Wala.
Pyro Gateway is a station by the jump point from Stanton to Pyro, the port of entry between them.
The jump point from Stanton to Pyro is a medium jump point.
Hurston Dynamics owns Pyro Gateway and added its logos and a statue of Archibald Hurston.
Pyro Gateway has a cargo deck, a refinery deck, a clinic, and ship repair and refueling.
On the Pyro side, Stanton Gateway sits in a dense nebula and debris field, making navigation treacherous.
Pyro's star is a K-type flare star, also known as a variable star.
Pyro has six planets: Pyro I, Monox, Bloom, Pyro IV, Pyro V and Terminus.
Pyrotechnic Amalgamated claimed Pyro in 2493 for its lucrative mining sites.
Intense solar flares drove Pyrotechnic Amalgamated to abandon Pyro in 2563.
Pyro has jump points to Cano, Castra, Hadrian, Nyx, Oso, Stanton and Terra.
No central authority governs Pyro; competing gangs rule ever-changing sectors of control.
Outlaw groups in Pyro include the Headhunters, Fire Rats, Rough and Ready, and XenoThreat.
XenoThreat is listed as the pack controlling Ruin Station, but that may change at a moment's notice.
Rough and Ready uses Orbituary to offer outlaws crossing the system fuel, supplies and a bit of entertainment.
Abandoned Pyrotechnic Amalgamated facilities were claimed by squatters, outlaws and former miners.
Citizens for Prosperity is one of the factions holding outposts on Bloom.
Ruin Station is an outlaw station orbiting Terminus in the Pyro system.
Ruin Station was originally called MacEwan Station.
Pyrotechnic Amalgamated founded Ruin Station in 2506 as its headquarters in the system.
Ruin Station is not suitable for tourism, regular trade or even experienced bounty hunters.
Ruin Station has a cargo deck, a refinery deck and a ship dealer.
Corner Four and a dive bar called Neutrality are aboard Ruin Station.
Checkmate Station sits at the L4 Lagrange point of Monox in Pyro.
Checkmate is the headquarters of Rough and Ready, a group of outlaws.
Pyrotechnic Amalgamated once ran Checkmate to supply its workers on Monox with fuel and resources.
The racetrack Fool's Run weaves through Checkmate's exterior.
Orbituary is a station in high orbit above Bloom.
Rough and Ready uses Orbituary to give outlaws traveling the system a place to stop.
Pyrotechnic Amalgamated originally established Orbituary to supply its workers with fuel and other resources.
Orbituary has shops, a clinic, a refinery deck, and ship repair and refueling.
Pyro I is a rocky planet dangerously close to the violent solar flares of its star.
Pyro I's surface temperature is approximately 220 degrees Celsius, and its atmosphere is toxic.
Violent storms around Pyro I can disable ships with distortion damage.
No significant mineral deposits have been found on Pyro I's surface.
Gray Gardens Depot, Rustville and Stag's Rut are on Pyro I.
Pyro II is nicknamed Monox for the carbon monoxide in its atmosphere.
Monox is a coreless planet that will, in time, fall into its star.
A metal rush saw human trade ships quickly deplete Monox of its deposits.
The Valakkar sandworm species lives on Monox.
Checkmate Station occupies the L4 Lagrange point of Monox.
Settlements on Monox include Jackson's Swap, Last Ditch and Sunset Mesa.
Bloom, Pyro III, has a breathable oxygen-nitrogen atmosphere.
Bloom has frozen biomes and expanses of liquid saltwater in its more temperate zones.
Bloom is known to be a haven for outlaws.
Orbituary, run by the Rough and Ready gang, orbits Bloom.
Prospect Depot and Starlight Service Station are among Bloom's facilities.
Pyro IV is a rocky protoplanet much like Mercury.
Astronomers believe a collision knocked Pyro IV out of its orbit and into orbit around Pyro V.
Pyro IV will either crash into Pyro V or be torn apart into a ring system.
Pyro IV's atmosphere is toxic, and breathing equipment is required on the surface.
Chawla's Beach and Dinger's Depot are on Pyro IV.
Pyro V is a massive yellow and green gas giant slowly pulling Pyro IV into its orbit.
Pyro V is a low-yield refueling point because of the poor hydrogen mix in its upper atmosphere.
All five of Pyro V's Lagrange points host former Pyrotechnic Amalgamated stations.
Gaslight and Rat's Nest are stations at Pyro V's Lagrange points.
Pyro V's moons include Ignis, Vatra, Adir, Fairo, Fuego and Vuur.
Terminus, Pyro VI, is barren and desolate, bombarded by Pyro's solar flares.
Terminus is extremely cold, and storms can drop daytime temperatures below minus 120 degrees Celsius.
The atmosphere of Terminus is laced with methane.
Ruin Station orbits Terminus.
Feuds between factions make Terminus extremely dangerous for civilians and outlaws alike.
Blackrock Exchange and Rough Landing are among the settlements on Terminus.
Nyx's star is an F-type main-sequence star.
The Glaciem Ring, a dense asteroid belt, and the nebula make Nyx a very good place to hide.
Nyx is unclaimed by the UEE.
Nyx I is a coreless world that the Gold Horizon corporation has mined clean.
Nyx III is an ice giant with no breathable atmosphere or valuable materials.
The navjumper Carla Larry discovered Nyx in 2582.
Nyx has jump points to Bremen, Castra, Odin, Pyro, Stanton, Tohil and Virgil.
Delamar is the largest asteroid in the Glaciem Ring of the Nyx system.
A borehole goes right through Delamar, with large parts of Levski on one side.
Delamar's mining facility was abandoned for years before refugees from the UEE moved in.
The settlement on Delamar was formed by free-thinkers during the oppressive Messer era.
Delamar is a refuge for political activists and those wishing to escape the eye of the Empire.
Levski is a free town grown from the old QV Planet Services mining facility on Delamar.
Levski is named for the ancient Earth revolutionary Vasil Levski, who dreamed of an egalitarian society.
Levski was founded by the People's Alliance and remains its headquarters.
Activists escaping the Messers found refuge in Delamar's vacated mining facility.
As word of the free town spread, anti-Messer activists, intellectuals and pacifists came to Levski.
Levski has a hospital, a refinery, ship sales and repairs, and the Grand Barter Bazaar.
The People's Alliance is an independent political group upholding an egalitarian society separate from the UEE.
The People's Alliance motto is stronger together.
The People's Alliance was founded in 2655 in an abandoned mining facility on Delamar.
The People's Alliance view of today's UEE can be summarised as complicated.
The People's Alliance follows six community rules stressing egalitarianism and peaceful conflict resolution.
Levski still accepts those who wish to live away from the UEE.
